version_semantics: Declared manifest requirement is not resolved version; latest_release null until verified against upstream; code-defined adapters may have no package version.

components.name: Node.js
components.declared_requirement: 24 minimum at root; >=22 in Host/Harness/Studio packages
components.use_case: Host, Studio, Harness and HQ processes
components.reason_to_evaluate: Node 24 unification simplifies use of built-in node:sqlite and avoids multiple toolchain assumptions.
components.alternative_question: Older Node may remain valid for certain local modules, but release should converge on tested runtime.

components.name: Bun
components.use_case: JS workspace manager and TierFlow test runner
components.reason_to_evaluate: Fast workspaces and test execution with one root package manager.
components.alternative_question: Compare install reproducibility, Windows behavior and native module compatibility with npm/pnpm.

components.name: Rust toolchain
components.use_case: HQKG, pure compute and Tauri launcher
components.reason_to_evaluate: Memory safety, native bounded pure compute and compact ABI opportunities.
components.alternative_question: Measure compile time, low disk footprint and target support before moving channels.

components.name: Tauri v2
components.use_case: Windows shell embedding local Host UI
components.reason_to_evaluate: Small native shell over system webview, Rust bridge and MSI packaging.
components.alternative_question: Never upgrade on version age alone: test upstream security advisories, ACL and Windows packaging.
watch_signals: Tauri v2 security and patch releases

components.name: Windows WebView2 and windows-rs
components.use_case: Windows system webview and native interop
components.reason_to_evaluate: Avoid shipping a separate embedded Chromium engine where OS webview suffices.
components.alternative_question: Evaluate WebView2 runtime compatibility and OS packaging matrix.

components.name: TypeScript
components.use_case: Typed TierFlow visual command contracts
components.reason_to_evaluate: Strict checks catch renderer/typed-command drift while runtime stays JS/TS.
components.alternative_question: Check actual compiler stability versus native preview on this codebase.

components.name: TypeScript native preview
components.use_case: Experimental typecheck path
components.reason_to_evaluate: Possible faster large-project checks; source already exposes typecheck:tsgo.
components.alternative_question: Never replace regular tsc gate until both outputs and diagnostic parity pass.

components.name: TierFlow in-repo package
components.use_case: Typed visual runtime/projections
components.reason_to_evaluate: Internal source-preserved visual renderer avoids separate product UI service.
components.alternative_question: Validate one publisher and revision semantics across desktop and PWA.

components.name: Chrome DevTools Protocol / signed-in browser
components.use_case: Read-only capture and signed-in browser integration
components.reason_to_evaluate: Works through user-controlled browser web sessions rather than provider APIs.
components.alternative_question: Check browser update churn, consent boundaries and profile isolation.

components.name: PWA + service worker
components.declared_requirement: Native web standards; no third-party UI framework declared
components.use_case: Paired Android/mobile-first surface
components.reason_to_evaluate: One web deployment path, installation without mandatory APK, cache/offline potential.
components.alternative_question: Test device signer, revocation, replay protections, offline persistence and cache quotas.
watch_signals: service worker and web crypto support

components.name: @vercel/blob
components.use_case: Optional cloud relay append-only command/status store
components.reason_to_evaluate: Private append-only objects and explicit revision paths support audit semantics.
components.alternative_question: Quantify operation costs, prune safety and whether cloud persistence is truly needed.
watch_signals: private Blob API or cost changes

components.name: Upstash Redis REST adapter
components.declared_requirement: No npm SDK declared; REST environment config
components.use_case: Optional relay state via Redis REST
components.reason_to_evaluate: Revision-keyed command status with TTL is a lightweight alternative to Blob.
components.alternative_question: Compare durability, privacy, consistency and cost; avoid implicit cloud authority.

components.name: Node built-in SQLite
components.use_case: Rebuildable HQ development intelligence index
components.reason_to_evaluate: Single-process local indexed source data without external DB server.
components.alternative_question: Verify SQLite API stability and transaction performance on Node 24.

components.name: rusqlite SQLite adapter
components.use_case: Optional Rust HQKG database integration
components.reason_to_evaluate: Native SQLite connector retains local-first persistence choice.
components.alternative_question: Do not infer live deployment from optional feature; compare bundle size and ABI.

components.name: postgres Rust crate
components.use_case: Optional database adapter
components.reason_to_evaluate: Allows future server-backed graph storage without changing core API.
components.alternative_question: Adoption should require a concrete data or concurrency need and no duplicate graph store.

components.name: Tokio
components.use_case: Native async runtime in Tauri crate
components.reason_to_evaluate: Mature Rust async executor for internal I/O coordination.
components.alternative_question: Test cancellation and task boundaries; never create second Host effect executor.

components.name: reqwest
components.use_case: Rust HTTP client for launcher/native integration
components.reason_to_evaluate: HTTP client without full default feature set can control dependency footprint.
components.alternative_question: Verify feature closure/TLS requirements on Windows under pinned Cargo lock.

components.name: Serde + serde_json
components.use_case: Typed native program/event serialization
components.reason_to_evaluate: Stable Rust data exchange for deterministic contracts.
components.alternative_question: Track JSON schema, forwards/backwards compatibility and unknown fields.

components.name: sha2
components.use_case: Hashing source facts and pure contract digests
components.reason_to_evaluate: Content-addressed evidence without introducing additional database engine.
components.alternative_question: Hashes establish integrity, not origin authentication or authorization.

components.name: Vercel deployment surface
components.use_case: Mobile relay endpoints and static rewrite config
components.reason_to_evaluate: Optional hosted relay path isolated from local Host authority.
components.alternative_question: Compare costs, privacy and whether cloud relay is needed under PWA-direct model.
